title: Mountain Entrepreneurship, a Vector of Sustainable Development in Europe
content: The article demonstrates the importance of developing mountain entrepreneurship, which faces interconnected challenges, such as the still weak representation of mountain businesses at European level, limited access to infrastructure, high production costs and dependence on climate factors. Mountain entrepreneurship plays a defining role in renewable development in Europe due to the high potential of natural resources, the ability to attract European funds for sustainable projects, and the contribution to the conservation of biodiversity and cultural heritage. The aforementioned sectors are part of industry, services and creative industries, which entitles the authors to carry out a detailed analysis of the related mountain entrepreneurship. Some case studies demonstrate the success of mountain entrepreneurship in Europe. Mountain entrepreneurship is the engine of European development more than the non-mountain one, which is why development must be sustained and resilient. In Europe, several countries with a mountain tradition or with a high degree of resilience show the importance of existing models and lessons of good practice. Future trends suggest an increase in interest in sustainable businesses and digitalization as a means of promoting mountain products and services. The aim of the article is to observe the state of play of some indicators related to European mountain entrepreneurship and propose solutions to ensure the sustainable development of the community economy.
